title: Job Tracker User Interface - Job Tracker
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

Welcome to our in-depth tutorial on the Job Tracker!  In this video, we'll take you through the complete user interface and highlight its powerful features to streamline your job search journey. Whether you're just starting out or looking to optimize your process, this guide has something for everyone! 

What We Will Cover:
- Overview of the Job Tracker interface
- How to navigate the table view like a spreadsheet
- Using chevrons as filters for job stages
- Tools for bulk actions: selecting, archiving, and grouping jobs
- Customizing your columns and sorting options
- Entering and managing job details within the tracker
- Understanding the importance of the excitement level for prioritizing jobs
- Insights on functionality as you add more jobs
- Accessing detailed job information and guidance through each stage

Questions Answered in This Video:
- What is the Job Tracker and how does it work?
- How can I filter my job search stages effectively?
- What tools are available for managing job applications?
- How do I customize my job tracking experience?
- What features become accessible as I add more jobs?
- How can I prioritize my job applications?
